title: SUPER PLANO GIGANTESCO DE MELHORIA
description: 100 granular improvement tasks organized sequentially into 10 squads for iterative enhancement without refactoring from scratch.

squads.name: API & Core Integration
squads.focus: Enhance API performance, stability, and connectivity with Evolution API, Chatwoot, and N8N.

squads.name: N8N Automation & Workflows
squads.focus: Optimize and robustify N8N workflows, error handling, and webhooks.

squads.name: Supabase & Database Optimization
squads.focus: Improve Supabase database performance, schemas, policies, and connection pooling.

squads.name: Redis & Caching Strategy
squads.focus: Optimize Redis caching layers, memory management, and session stores.

squads.name: Chatwoot & CRM Enhancements
squads.focus: Improve Chatwoot integration, macros, agent handoffs, and sidekiq processing.

squads.name: Evolution API & WhatsApp
squads.focus: Stabilize WhatsApp connections, optimize media handling, and improve webhook delivery.

squads.name: OpenClaw AI & Bot Optimization
squads.focus: Tune the AI agent, prompts, tool calling efficiency, and cost management.

squads.name: Security & LGPD Compliance
squads.focus: Strengthen data protection, audit logs, PII masking, and access controls.

squads.name: Monitoring & Observability
squads.focus: Improve logging, Prometheus metrics, dashboards, and alerting systems.

squads.name: Infrastructure & CI/CD
squads.focus: Enhance Docker, EasyPanel deployment, CI/CD pipelines, and environment parity.
